# PHARYNGITIS AND TONSILLITIS

Most cases are viral, primarily due to adenovirus. Aside from streptococcal and gonococcal pharyngitis, antimicrobials are not indicated. For gonococcal pharyngitis, use link below for recommendations.

[Treatment of Gonorrheal Infections](gonococcal)

Consider HIV screening for patients with pharyngitis.

HIV Rapid Test

## Streptococcal Pharyngitis and Tonsillitis

Diagnosis of group A streptococcal (GAS) infection is made through detection by rapid PCR and should be reserved for patients who have a moderate to high risk of GAS infection according to the Modified Centor Score. Use link below for Modified Centor score criteria and for more details.

[Pharyngitis/Tonsillitis and Modified Centor score](more-about-pharyngitis)

Rapid Strep A throat PCR testing lab order

## Outpatient Guidance

## PHARYNGITIS AND TONSILLITIS

HIV AG/AB Lab

## GAS Pharyngitis and Tonsillitis Treatment

Preferred:
Penicillin V 500 mg PO BID for 10 days ($) [R]

Primary alternative:
[Assess Beta-lactam allergy prior to ordering alternative](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)

Secondary alternative, after assessment of beta-lactam reaction above:
Azithromycin 500 mg PO once on day one then 250mg PO qday for 4 days ($) [M]

## ER Guidance

## PHARYNGITIS AND TONSILLITIS

Treatment of Gonorrheal Infections - Opt CDSS, change parental orders to STAT

## Streptococcal Pharyngitis and Tonsillitis

More About Pharyngitis/Tonsillitis and Modified Centor score - Opt CDSS

## GAS Pharyngitis and Tonsillitis Treatment

Benzathine penicillin 1.2 million units IM once STAT ($$$) [M]

## PCR Negative, Viral and Other Non-GAS Causes of Pharyngitis Treatment

Antimicrobials are not indicated

## GAS Pharyngitis and Tonsillitis Treatment

Preferred:
Penicillin V 500 mg PO q12h for 10 days ($) [R]
< OR >
Benzathine penicillin 1.2 million units IM x 1 ($$$) [M]

Primary alternative:
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)
Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO q12h for 10 days ($) [R]

Secondary alternative, after assessment of beta-lactam reaction above:
Azithromycin 500 mg PO once on day one then 250mg PO qday for 4 days ($) [M]
